snippet.title: Redhowl - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
❤️ If you like what you see, *adding Redhowl to your Steam wishlist* really helps us: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3873330/Redhowl/

🐺 Join our Discord to *take part in playtests* and help shape the game with us: https://discord.gg/yZn6vk7ATp

Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. 3 factions clash: use your unique powers and unmask them before the Blood Moon turns against you, or be devoured.

If you enjoy games like Among Us, Town of Salem, or Loups-Garous de Thiercelieux (Werewolf), you will love this new game.
